title: Step 2 - UCB Algorithm in R: Calculating Average Reward & Confidence Interval

cues.en: -: Hello and welcome to this art tutorial.
cues.zh: 講師：大家好，歡迎來到 R 教學。

cues.en: So in the previous tutorial, we imported the data set and today in this tutorial we are going to implement the UCB, upper confidence bound algorithm.

cues.en: So this algorithm takes three steps.

cues.en: The first step is at each round end we consider two numbers for each AD I that is for each version of the AD.
cues.zh: 第一步，每回合 n，對每個廣告 i，也就是廣告版本，考慮兩個數字。

cues.zh: 第一個是 Nᵢ(n)，截至回合 n，廣告 i 被選的次數。

cues.en: And the sum of rewards of the AD version I up to round N.
cues.zh: 第二個是截至回合 n，廣告版本 i 的獎勵總和。

cues.en: Okay, so the first thing that we need to do here is to declare these two variables because we will need them afterwards.
cues.zh: 首先宣告兩個變數，稍後會用到。

cues.en: Okay, So the first one, the number of times that AD I was selected up to round N.
cues.zh: 第一個，廣告 i 截至回合 n 被選的次數。

cues.zh: 就叫 numbers_of_selections。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So we need to consider this number for each AD I.
cues.zh: 每個廣告 i 都要考慮這個數字。

cues.en: So what we're gonna do is create a vector that will contain each of those numbers of selections of each AD I.
cues.zh: 所以建立向量，包含每個廣告的選取次數。

cues.en: So we will set this variable equal to a vector of size D and we will initialize all the D components of this vector to zero.
cues.zh: 向量大小 d，所有 d 個分量初始化為 0。

cues.en: And so how can we do that in R?
cues.zh: R 裡怎麼做？

cues.en: Well, we simply need to type integer and in parenthesis D and this will create a vector of size D containing only zeros.
cues.zh: 只要輸入 integer，括號放 d，就會建立大小 d、全是 0 的向量。

cues.en: And we are doing this because of course at the first round each version of the AD hasn't been selected yet.
cues.zh: 因為最初每個版本都還沒被選過。

cues.en: So the number of times each version of the AD was selected is of course zero.
cues.zh: 所以選取次數當然是 0。

cues.en: Okay, so done for the first number.
cues.zh: 第一個數字完成。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And the second number is the sum of rewards of the AD I up to round N.
cues.zh: 第二個是截至回合 n，廣告 i 的獎勵總和。

cues.en: Okay, so let's call this variable, sums of rewards, this way.

cues.en: And same, you know, we need to take the sums of rewards of each version of the AD at each round N.

cues.en: So we are gonna set it as a vector of D components as well exactly like we did for numbers of selections.

cues.en: And same, we will initialize it to zero because of course at the first round, the sums of rewards of each version of the AD is of course zero.

cues.en: So we will just copy this, copy and paste it here.
cues.zh: 複製貼上這裡。

cues.en: All right, so basically step one done.
cues.zh: 第一步基本上完成。

cues.en: Now let's move on on to step two.
cues.zh: 進入第二步。

cues.en: Step two is from these two numbers.
cues.zh: 根據這兩個數字，

cues.en: We compute first the average reward of AD I up to round N.

cues.en: And second, the confidence interval at round N.
cues.zh: 再計算回合 n 的信賴區間。

cues.en: So basically we need to compute these two numbers but at each round N.
cues.zh: 基本上，每回合都要計算這兩個數字。

cues.en: So let's implement this step two.
cues.zh: 來實作第二步。

cues.en: Since we need to compute these two numbers at each round N, of course, what we need to do is to make a four loop.
cues.zh: 既然每回合都要算，當然需要 for 迴圈。

cues.en: All right, so that's what we're gonna do.
cues.zh: 現在就來做。

cues.en: We are going to go through all the rounds from zero to the 10 thousandths round, so four each round N.
cues.zh: 走遍從 0 到第一萬回合的所有回合，對每回合 n，

cues.en: We need to compute for each version of the AD the average award, and the confidence interval.

cues.en: So that's exactly what we're gonna do.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: And since we're doing it for each version of the AD I, well what we need to do now is again, another four loop.
cues.zh: 既然是針對每個廣告 i，就再寫另一個 for 迴圈。

cues.zh: 這次走遍十個版本。

cues.zh: 廣告以 i 作索引。

cues.en: So for I here, N, one and then again we're gonna input here D in case you have more versions

cues.en: And since it's the number of ADs we will set it equal to 10.

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And now we're entering into the second loop.
cues.zh: 現在進入第二個迴圈。

cues.en: So right now at this level we are at a specific round and dealing with a specific version of the AD.
cues.zh: 在這層，處於特定回合、處理特定廣告版本。

cues.en: And now we can compute our two numbers, the average reward of the AD I and the confidence interval.
cues.zh: 現在可以計算廣告 i 的平均獎勵，以及信賴區間。

cues.en: So let's start with the first number.
cues.zh: 先從第一個數字。

cues.en: The first number is the average reward.
cues.zh: 就是平均獎勵。

cues.en: So let's call it average reward and equal.

cues.en: It says that it's the sum of rewards of the AD version I up to round N divided by the number of times this AD version I was selected up to round N.
cues.zh: 截至回合 n，廣告版本 i 的獎勵總和，除以被選的次數。

cues.en: So simply let's write this formula.
cues.zh: 直接寫這公式。

cues.en: We already have these two variables where we have the vectors, but of course we will take the ice element of these two vectors because they can respond

cues.en: So let's do it, sums of rewards.

cues.en: And we take the ice element of this vector divided by numbers of selections.
cues.zh: 取第 i 個元素，除以 numbers_of_selections。

cues.en: And same, we're taking the ice element of this vector.
cues.zh: 一樣取第 i 個元素。

cues.en: Great.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: So we have our first number computed, the average reward.
cues.zh: 第一個數字，平均獎勵，算好了。

cues.en: Now let's take care of the second number, the confidence interval.
cues.zh: 接著第二個，信賴區間。

cues.zh: 不會建立整個區間，現在計算它的上界，因為第三步需要這個。

cues.en: As you can see, step three is we select the AD that has the maximum upper confidence bound.
cues.zh: 如你所見，第三步選信賴上界最大的廣告。

cues.en: So we just need the upper confidence bound of this confidence interval.
cues.zh: 所以只需要信賴區間的上界。

cues.en: And so what is this upper confidence bound?
cues.zh: 這個上界是什麼？

cues.en: Well, it's the average reward plus delta I of N and delta I of n is given by this formula.
cues.zh: 平均獎勵加 delta_i(n)，而 delta_i(n) 由這公式給出。

cues.en: It's the square root of 1.5 log N divided by N I N which is the number of times the AD version I was selected up to round N.
cues.zh: 1.5 乘 log n，除以 Nᵢ(n)，再開平方根；Nᵢ(n) 是廣告 i 截至回合 n 被選的次數。

cues.en: So let's compute this delta first and then will compute the upper confidence bound.
cues.zh: 先算 delta，再算信賴上界。

cues.en: So delta we'll call it actually delta underscore I.
cues.zh: 變數叫 delta_i。

cues.en: And so it's equal to square root which I call S Q R T.
cues.zh: 等於平方根，函式叫 sqrt。

cues.en: Parenthesis here.
cues.zh: 加括號。

cues.en: Okay, so what do we have first?
cues.zh: 首先是什麼？

cues.en: We have this three divided by two then times and then we take the log.
cues.zh: 3 除以 2，再乘以 log。

cues.en: So log here of N that we divide by the numbers of selections of the AD version I.
cues.zh: log n，再除以廣告 i 的選取次數，

cues.en: That is the number of times the AD version I was selected up to round N.
cues.zh: 也就是截至回合 n 的選取次數。

cues.en: Okay, so great for delta, delta is ready and therefore now we're ready to compute the upper confidence bound which is all the essence of this UCB algorithm.
cues.zh: 好，delta 完成，準備計算信賴上界，這是 UCB 的精髓。

cues.en: So let's do it.
cues.zh: 開始。

cues.en: Let's compute the UCB and let's call it upper bound.
cues.zh: 計算 UCB，叫 upper_bound。

cues.en: This way upper bound equals average reward plus delta I,
cues.zh: upper_bound 等於 average_reward 加 delta_i，

cues.en: exactly like in the slide.
cues.zh: 和投影片一樣。

cues.en: Okay, so great, we just computed the average reward and the upper bound, and therefore we are done with step two.
cues.zh: 很好，平均獎勵和上界算好了，第二步完成。

cues.en: So now let's move on to step three.
cues.zh: 進第三步。

cues.zh: 現在稍微複雜，因為要建立一個大向量，像大型清單，包含
